name: When should I consider replacing my tile roof instead of just repairing it?

mainEntity.name: When should I consider replacing my tile roof instead of just repairing it?

acceptedAnswer.text: You should consider replacing your tile roof rather than repairing it when repairs become frequent, extensive, or no longer cost-effective. If your roof is nearing the end of its typical lifespan (50+ years for many tile types), or if there's widespread damage to the underlayment, multiple areas of leakage, or significant structural issues, replacement might be the more economical long-term solution. A professional assessment can help determine if repeated repairs are a temporary fix for a larger, systemic problem.
acceptedAnswer.description: Consider replacing your tile roof if repairs are frequent, extensive, or no longer cost-effective, especially if the roof is nearing its lifespan or has widespread damage.
